blocks.alt: Lush, Leaning, and Sustainable: Transforming a Beachside Paradise

blocks.v: Lush, Leaning, and Sustainable: Transforming a Beachside Paradise

Perched on the stunning shores of Maremegmeg Beach, this coastal paradise transforms a steep slope into a lush, functional, and sustainable sanctuary. Native, drought-tolerant plants withstand salty winds while enriching the soil and providing shade and privacy. Lush greenery frames the azure waters, flowering shrubs add vibrant accents, and soft lawns invite relaxation. Every element reflects careful planning, environmental mindfulness, and a commitment to lasting coastal luxury.

Led by professional and technical personnel, the ball-out and tree planting operations in San Vicente are carried out using sustainable landscaping practices and proper transplanting protocols. This ensures high survival rates, minimal environmental impact, and long-term ecological benefits for the site.

blocks.alt: Reviving a Botanical Haven: A Garden of Rare Treasures

blocks.v: Reviving a Botanical Haven: A Garden of Rare Treasures

The once-outdated landscape has been transformed into a botanical sanctuary that honors its roots while embracing modern sophistication. Preserving what works and replacing what no longer thrives, the garden now features rare species, exotic forms, and collector’s varieties. Layered canopies, understory foliage, and bold specimens create a living museum—an immersive haven where plant enthusiasts and nature lovers can explore a vibrant, revitalized landscape.

blocks.alt: A Tropical Escape at Home: The New Face of Residential Landscaping

blocks.v: A Tropical Escape at Home: The New Face of Residential Landscaping

Transform your residential garden into a vibrant tropical retreat. Picture a space where palms sway, colorful shrubs brighten the view, and layers of greenery create depth and calm. A soft, open lawn anchors the garden, inviting rest, play, and quiet moments. With curated tropical plants and simple pathways, the design blends beauty and function. Low-maintenance species, natural textures, and earthy tones turn your outdoor space into a soothing escape—perfect for unwinding and reconnecting with nature at home.

pages.title: About Greenscape - Greenscape Landscaping Services | Palawan
pages.description: Greenscape is an enterprise that provides quality landscaping, garden design, maintenance, and care services. We deliver professional outdoor solutions for residential and commercial clients.

blocks.v: Greenscape is a premier landscaping enterprise delivering sustainable, high-quality design, execution, and maintenance services, backed by extensive plant resources and a team of skilled landscaping experts.

Greenscape is an enterprise that is an expert in providing Quality service in the field of landscaping: with a wide variety Of plant resources and supply and a group of highly- skilled and knowledgeable gardeners. Our main objective is delivering High-caliber sustainable outputs spanning from design and execution to maintenance and care.

Through the collaboration of our farms: a 3.2 Hectare nursery plant production in Aborlan and a 7.3 Hectare ornamental plant production in Taytay, and with our main hub in Puerto Princesa that serve as our epicenter, we are able to cater to multiple resorts and business across the province, from north, all the way down to the south, and even to the nearby island and islets around mainland. We aim to cultivate and nurture our inovative sparks to widen our scope and range while remaining genuine to the core that stands as our cornerstone.

At Greenscape, we believe in the transformative power of education, training, and support to uplift communities and foster a sustainable future. Through our comprehensive community and social responsibility initiatives, we strive to make a meaningful impact on the lives of individuals and the environment they inhabit. Here's a glimpse into our efforts:

Education is the cornerstone of progress, and we are proud to offer scholarships to deserving students pursuing any course of duty. We recognize that many talented individuals lack the financial means to support their education aspirations, which is why we extend a helping hand to those in need. Our scholarship program aims to remove barriers to education, enabling students to unlock their full potential and pursue their dreams.

As a part of our commitment to nurturing future talent, we offer internship opportunities in landscaping and garden maintenance to students enrolled in the K-12 program of the department of education. Through hands-on experience and mentorship, interns gain valuable skills that will serve as their edge throughout their respective careers of choice in the future.

We believe in the power of empowerment through education and skills development. That's why we offer landscaping and garden maintenance training programs specifically tailored for women in the community, the public sector, and select government offices. By providing access to training opportunities, we empower the community and economic independence.

We understand the importance of supporting local entrepreneurs and fostering sustainable livelihoods within our communities. That's why we partner with small-scale and backyard gardeners, offering support and resources to help their businesses thrive. We purchase plants and other garden products from these entrepreneurs, providing them with a steady source of income and helping them to expand their operations. Through this partnership, we promote economic resilience and encourage sustainable practices in gardening and agriculture.

blocks.v: Transform your outdoor space with our proven landscaping process.

First, Greenscape assesses the area, discuss the clients vision, budget, materials, and maintenance needs, evaluate natural conditions like soil condition, sunlight orientation, water supply and drainage. Site visits within the city are free. For locations within 60 km from our office, the site visit fee starts at 3,000 pesos.
Prepare a conceptual design with perspectives and detailed Bill of Quantities.

Greenscape then prepares a conceptual design, complete with perspectives and a detailed 'Bill of Quantities', and select plants and materials that ensure an optimal balance between aesthetic appeal and low maintenance. This is followed by presenting the design for client review and incorporate feedback to finalize the proposal. The design fee for residential properties not exceeding 150 sqm starts at P15,000.00.
Install hardscape elements, prepare land, plant greenery, and set up systems.

Next is the installation of hardscape elements and land preparations, followed by planting of trees, shrubs, and ground cover then Set up lighting and irrigation system. The landscaping installation cost starts at P1,560 per sqm, with the final price varying based on design complexity, materials, specifications, location, and schedule.
Introduce a maintenance plan covering watering, pruning, fertilizing, and garden pest control, to maintain the functionality, beauty and sustainability of the garden.

To maintain the functionality, beauty, and sustainability of your garden, we introduce a comprehensive maintenance plan. This covers essential care including watering schedules, pruning, fertilizing, and garden pest control. Regular maintenance ensures your landscape investment continues to thrive and enhance your property for years to come.
